risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or non-working lens)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording video, or a photo of the camera's menu screen and a sample photo taken with it.

risks.risk: Lens may have scratches, fungus, or haze on the glass
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements, ideally with a white background to reveal imperfections.

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be faulty or non-original
risks.proof: A photo of the battery inserted into the camera with the camera powered on, or a video of the charger charging the battery.

risks.risk: Camera may have physical damage or dents not visible in the photo
risks.proof: A 360-degree photo or video showing all sides of the camera body and lens.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having hidden physical damage
